claim_text: Fortescue delivered another year of strong performance in FY25, exceeding stretch targets across safety, production, and financial metrics.
metric_name: Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR); Leading Safety Index (LSI); Critical Incident Frequency Rate (CIFR)
context_text: Underpinned by our unique culture and Values, and a focus on operational excellence and cost discipline, Fortescue delivered another year of strong performance in FY25, exceeding stretch targets across safety, production, and financial metrics.；Safety remains a core value at Fortescue, underpinning everything we do. In FY25, we achieved a Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) of 1.3, an industry-leading result that surpassed our target of 1.8.；We exceeded our internal target of 100, achieving an impressive score of 140.5. We also tracked our Critical Incident Frequency Rate (CIFR), with an FY25 target of 0.08. Fortescue outperformed this goal, recording a record low CIFR of 0.02.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告给出了TRIFR、LSI、CIFR等实际绩效数据，并明确显示其超过内部目标，能够直接支撑“exceeding stretch targets across safety”的表述。
notes: 证据合并自同页多处表述。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that in FY25 Fortescue “exceed[ed] stretch targets across safety, production, and financial metrics,” implying broad outperformance across multiple categories. The evidence substantively supports the safety portion: it reports FY25 TRIFR of 1.3 versus a target of 1.8 (surpassed), an LSI score of 140.5 versus an internal target of 100 (exceeded), and a CIFR of 0.02 versus a target of 0.08 (outperformed). However, the provided evidence includes no production or financial metrics, targets, or results, and it does not substantiate that the exceeded targets were specifically “stretch targets” beyond being described as targets. Therefore, only the safety part of the broader claim is verified.
